notices.text: Clear the gateway's pm2 output log (logs/production/gateway-out.log on a standard install) after updating. Every web login before this release wrote the user's password to it in plain text; the logging is gone but the old lines are not.

This update cannot warn your callers before it stops the BBS: the processes it replaces predate maintenance mode. Updates after this one close the board, warn callers and web users, and wait for network work in progress to finish first.
